root_cause.text: The `need_futex_hash_allocate_default()` function incorrectly required both `CLONE_THREAD` and `CLONE_VM` flags, causing it to skip allocating a default futex hash for processes that share an mm (`CLONE_VM`) but are not threads (e.g., `clone(CLONE_VM)` without `CLONE_THREAD`), leading to a use-after-free when the percpu `mm->futex_ref` counter later points to freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in futex_hash_put ... where the +1 bias can end up on a percpu counter that mm->futex_ref no longer points at." The patch changes the condition from `(clone_flags & (CLONE_THREAD | CLONE_VM)) != (CLONE_THREAD | CLONE_VM)` to `(clone_flags & (CLONE_VM | CLONE_VFORK)) == CLONE_VM`, explicitly removing the `CLONE_THREAD` requirement to cover any `CLONE_VM` clone except vfork.
